assets.title: Claude Code Terminal Sprint
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code types rapidly at a terminal. Key presses, cursor timing, body recoil, and contact shadow are synchronized.

assets.title: Claude Code Bug Hunt
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code follows a scuttling bug with a damped magnifying-glass swing and grounded pursuit motion.

assets.title: Claude Code Git Merge
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Two Git branches accelerate toward a springy merge while Claude Code reacts with anticipation and recovery.

assets.title: Claude Code Context Juggle
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Three context cards follow staggered parabolic arcs with rotational inertia while Claude Code maintains balance.

assets.title: Claude Code Release Launch
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code braces for a rocket launch with anticipation, recoil, accelerating ascent, exhaust flicker, and expanding smoke.

assets.title: Claude Code Review Pass
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. A review sheet slides in under friction, comments resolve, a check draws, and Claude Code answers with a damped nod.

assets.title: Claude Code Pair Session
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code pairs with a terminal through timed message exchanges, cursor rhythm, and subtle attention shifts.

assets.title: Claude Code Refactor Pull
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code leans against a tensioned code rope, collapsing a tangle into three orderly modules with spring recovery.

assets.title: Claude Code Test Lab
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Three test cards fall under gravity, compress on contact, settle, and light green while Claude Code watches.

assets.title: Claude Code Coffee Compile
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code sips during a compile. The cup tilts while the liquid counter-rotates to stay level and steam rises buoyantly.

assets.title: Claude Code Focus Lock
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code breathes at center while distraction cards orbit, decelerate, shrink, and disappear into focus mode.

assets.title: Claude Code Memory Search
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. A magnifying lens scans memory cards with damped travel; each card lifts as the scan passes over it.

assets.title: Claude Code Package Drop
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. A package accelerates downward, compresses at impact, rebounds, and transfers energy into a secondary lid bounce.

assets.title: Claude Code Incident Response
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code dashes toward an incident and fires an extinguishing blast that displaces flame and releases fading smoke.

assets.title: Claude Code Branch Swing
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code swings from a Git branch as a pendulum; the body counter-rotates to preserve balance and the shadow tracks arc position.

assets.title: Claude Code Token Rain
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Tokens accelerate under gravity and spin at different rates while an umbrella compresses on impact over Claude Code.

assets.title: Claude Code Prompt Fishing
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code waits for a prompt bite, then loads the rod, stretches the line, and lifts a catch with elastic overshoot.

assets.title: Claude Code Agent Conductor
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code conducts three task cards through a synchronized pipeline with baton rhythm and phase-shifted card motion.

assets.title: Claude Code Build Sleep
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code sleeps through a build with slow breathing, synchronized shadow expansion, buoyant Zs, and a gentle success notification.

assets.title: Claude Code Victory Dance
assets.description: Community-created animated scene using the supplied Claude Code mark. Claude Code performs a squash-and-stretch victory dance with two airborne beats, responsive shadowing, expanding energy ring, and falling confetti.
